llm.summary: This is an instruction-only skill that documents how to call animalhouse.ai's Goose virtual-pet HTTP API — it doesn't request unrelated credentials, install code, or ask the agent to access local secrets or system files.

dimensions.detail: The name/description advertise a virtual pet backed by animalhouse.ai and the SKILL.md contains only curl examples and endpoint documentation for that service. There are no unrelated requirements (no cloud creds, no extra binaries) that would be disproportionate to a web-API integration.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to making HTTP calls to animalhouse.ai endpoints (register, adopt, status, care, etc.) and storing/using a bearer token returned by the service. The instructions do not direct the agent to read local files, system config, or other environment variables, nor to transmit data to unknown endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files — this is the lowest-risk form (instruction-only). Nothing is downloaded or written to disk by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials. The only auth material referenced is a service bearer token returned by animalhouse.ai during registration (the doc shows the token is to be saved by the user). That is proportional for a third-party API integration; users should treat that token like a password.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true and is user-invocable. Model invocation is allowed (the platform default) but the skill does not ask for permanent system-level presence or to modify other skill configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is essentially documentation + curl examples for a third-party virtual-pet API (animalhouse.ai). Before using it, consider: 1) You will need to register on animalhouse.ai and store a bearer token (treat it as a secret). Do not paste tokens into public chat or logs. 2) The skill will cause the agent to send whatever you include (names, notes, prompts, images) to animalhouse.ai — check the service's privacy/terms if that matters. 3) Verify the service URL and GitHub repo if you require provenance (the SKILL.md points to animalhouse.ai and a GitHub org). 4) Because this skill is instruction-only, it won’t write code or install binaries on your system, but any sensitive data you include in requests will be transmitted to the external site. If those aspects are acceptable, the skill is coherent with its stated purpose.
